name: What types of wood are commonly used for deck construction?

mainEntity.name: What types of wood are commonly used for deck construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common wood types for deck construction include pressure-treated pine, cedar, and redwood. Pressure-treated pine is a popular choice due to its affordability and resistance to rot and insects, making it a practical tradeoff for many homeowners. Cedar and redwood offer natural beauty and decay resistance but typically come at a higher cost. When choosing, consider the climate in areas like Alameda or Berkeley, as certain woods perform better in specific weather conditions, influencing the deck's longevity and maintenance needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common wood types for decks are pressure-treated pine, cedar, and redwood, each with different costs and properties. Consider your local climate and budget when choosing.
